title: Play with fire and perish: China issues sharp warning to Japan on Taiwan issue
description: China warned Japan not to play with fire after PM Sanae Takaichi suggested possible military involvement over Taiwan, accusing Tokyo of violating the one-China principle and threatening consequences unless the remarks are withdrawn.

title: China to Japan's PM: Retract 'egregious' remarks on Taiwan
description: BEIJING — China’s foreign ministry on Thursday demanded Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi to retract what it called her “egregious” remarks related to Taiwan, warning that otherwise Japan “must bear all consequences” for the comments.

title: Taiwanese Legislator Tackles Disinformation at German Parliament Amid China's Charges
description: Puma Shen, a Taiwanese legislator targeted by China for promoting Taiwan's independence, addressed a German parliamentary committee on disinformation by autocratic states. Despite Chinese threats, Shen emphasized Taiwan's democratic resilience and global advocacy. The session highlighted disinformation impacts, drawing attention to risks in Europe and Taiwan.
